figures.alt: Downspout connected to a buried drain extension with a cleanout beside a Florida home
figures.caption: Keep sump discharge separate from roof runoff and give it a clear, serviceable route away from the foundation. A buried outlet needs a real path, not a low spot that creates a new flooding problem.

figures.alt: Roof runoff directed through a rock-lined swale away from a Florida foundation
figures.caption: Test the float, check valve, alarm, and backup arrangement before closing the pit. Humid conditions, storms, and outages make routine checks more important than a one-time installation.
